name: Adzuna
tagline: Multi-country job search API with salary estimates
description: Adzuna provides a job search API across multiple countries with search, category, and salary estimate endpoints. Developers can query listings and market salary data via a free app-id/app-key tier.

auth.details: app_id and app_key query parameters; self-serve signup

use_cases: search jobs by keyword and location
get salary estimates for a role
